Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
COUPLING NUTS FOR OIL HYDRAULIC*SYSTEM 

( First Revision ) 



1. Scope — Specifies dimensions, material and other requirements for coupling nuts for use in oil 
hydraulic systems. 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

3. Material — Steel conforming to designation 14C14S14of IS :.4431-1978 'Specification for carbon 
and carbon-manganese free cutting steel ( first revision)', or any other steel as agreed to between 
the user and the manufacturer. 

4. Surface Protection — Coupling nuts shall be: 

a) phosphated to Class A2 of IS : 3618-1966 'Specification for phosphate treatment of iron and 
steel for protection against corrosion', or 

b) any other surface protection, for example, zinc plating as agreed to between the manufacturer 
and the user. 

5. General Requirements — For details not covered in this standard, reference shall be made to 
IS : 8805 ( Part 1 )-1 978 'General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oil-hydraulic 
systems: Part 1 General. 

6. Designation 

6.1 A coupling nut of light series L for outside diameter of tube 12 mm conforming to this standard 
shall be designated as: 

Coupling Nut L12 IS : 8803 

7. Form of Thread Run Out and Undercut — The manufacturer may use any of the two undercut 
forms X1 or X2. 

8. Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was first published in 1978. The following changes have been made in the 
present revision: 

a) For internal thread end, form with undercut has been deleted. 

b) Runout (details at x) along with its reference to IS : 1369 'Dimension for screw thread 
runouts and undercuts', has been deleted since dimensions 16, tl and b are sufficient for 
manufacture. 

c) Alternative form of nut with shoulder as per manufacturer's choice has been included. 

d) Zinc plating as alternative surface protection has been included. 

e) Nominal pressure has been added in the table. 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from DIN 3878- 
1983 'Non soldered and soldered nipple type fittings, union nuts', issued by the Deutsches Institut 
for Normung ( DIN ). 



Adopted 2 June 1987
